question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Buy a lemon

options.text: The ability to know what's happening
To buy something that is worthless

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"buy a lemon"** means: *'To buy something that is worthless'.*
 
• **"Buy a lemon"** is a phrase often used to refer to a car that is found to be defective only after it has been bought. 
 
• In general, it can refer to any purchase that turns out to be worth less than expected.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:* 'To buy something that is worthless'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To not complain:** This means not expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance about something. (शिकायत नहीं करना)
 
• **The ability to know what's happening: **This refers to being aware of or able to understand the situation or circumstances.(जो हो रहा है उसे जानने की क्षमता)
 
• **Wear fashionable clothing: **This means to dress in stylish or trendy clothes.(फैशनेबल कपड़े पहनना)
